camel_example: aliyun smartag AddACLRule --region cn-hangzhou --Policy accept --DestCidr '192.168.10.0/24' --SourcePortRange '1/200' --SourceCidr '192.168.20.0/24' --AclId 'acl-xhwhyuo43l0n00000' --IpProtocol tcp --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DestPortRange '1/200' --Direction in --version 2018-03-13 --method POST --force
description_zh: 调用AddACLRule接口添加访问控制规则
kebab_example: aliyun smartag add-acl-rule --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --acl-id acl-xhwhyuo43l0n00000 --direction in --source-cidr 192.168.20.0/24 --dest-cidr 192.168.10.0/24 --ip-protocol tcp --source-port-range 1/200 --dest-port-range 1/200 --policy accept --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddACLRule

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the access control instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the access control instance
parameters.name: acl_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the access control rule.

The description must be 1 to 512 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制规则描述信息。

描述长度为1~512个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The direction in which the access control rule is applied. Valid values:

in: inbound. Traffic from the Internet to the local branch where the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) instance is deployed.
out: outbound. Traffic from the local branch where the SAG instance is deployed to the Internet
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制规则应用方向。取值：

in：入方向，指从外部访问智能接入网关实例所在的本地分支的流量。
out：出方向，指从智能接入网关实例所在的本地分支访问外部的流量
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en:
The source CIDR block.

The source CIDR block must be in CIDR format. Example: 192.168.1.0/24
parameters.help_zh:
源网段。

源网段格式为CIDR格式。例如：192.168.1.0/24
parameters.name: source_cidr

parameters.help_en:
The destination CIDR block.

The destination CIDR block must be in CIDR format. Example: 192.168.10.0/24
parameters.help_zh:
目的网段。

目的网段格式为CIDR格式。例如：192.168.10.0/24
parameters.name: dest_cidr

parameters.help_en:
The protocol used by the access control rule.

For the protocol types supported by the access control feature, refer to the console. The protocol format is not case-sensitive
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制规则应用的协议。

访问控制功能支持的协议类型，请以控制台为准。协议格式不区分大小写
parameters.name: ip_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The source port range.

Valid values: -1 or 1 to 65535.

The source port range is in the format of X/Y, such as 1/200 or 80/80. A value of -1/-1 indicates that all ports are allowed
parameters.help_zh:
源端口范围。

取值范围：-1或1~65535。

源端口范围格式例如：1/200、80/80，其中-1/-1代表不限制端口
parameters.name: source_port_range

parameters.help_en:
The destination port range.

Valid values: -1 or 1 to 65535.

The destination port range is in the format of X/Y, such as 1/200 or 80/80. A value of -1/-1 indicates that all ports are allowed
parameters.help_zh:
目的端口范围。

取值范围：-1或1~65535。

目的端口范围格式例如：1/200、80/80，其中-1/-1代表不限制端口
parameters.name: dest_port_range

parameters.help_en:
The authorization policy of the access control rule. Valid values:

accept: Allow.

drop: Deny
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制规则授权策略。取值：

accept：允许。

drop：拒绝
parameters.name: policy

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the access control rule.

A smaller value indicates a higher priority. If multiple rules have the same priority, the rule that is first delivered to the Smart Access Gateway device takes effect first.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制规则优先级。

数值越小，优先级越高。同优先级时，首先下发到智能接入网关设备的规则优先生效。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：1
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
The type of the access control rule. Valid values:

LAN: private network. This is the default value. It specifies the Settings of access control rules for traffic of the private endpoint.

WAN: public network. It specifies the Settings of access control rules for traffic of public IP addresses
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制规则类型。取值：

LAN：（默认值）私网，表示针对私网地址的流量设置访问控制规则。

WAN：公网，表示针对公网地址的流量设置访问控制规则
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the access control rule.

The name must be 2 to 100 characters in length, and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制规则名称。

长度为2~100个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the applications matched by the access control rule.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196630.html operation to query application IDs and the corresponding application information. Maximum value of N: 10
parameters.help_zh:
当前访问控制规则匹配的应用ID列表。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196630.html查询应用ID及其对应的应用信息。N的最大值为**10**
parameters.name: dpi_signature_ids

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the application groups matched by the access control rule.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196754.html operation to query application group IDs and the included application information. Maximum value of N: 10
parameters.help_zh:
当前访问控制规则匹配的应用组ID列表。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196754.html查询应用组ID及其包含的应用信息。N的最大值为**10**
parameters.name: dpi_group_ids
